title: The Debt of Warmth
subtitle: A surgeon's account of Sarn
tagline: He died with his hands around a child in the snow, and woke in a world that taxes the dead for the heat they carried.
cover_motif: A cupped hand seen in profile, holding a single coal; a hairline crack runs through the palm, and the coal's heat escapes along it as one thin thread of gold. The hand is the vessel, the coal is the Warm, and the crack is the whole argument of the saga.
genre_notes: Reincarnation isekai; dark medical fantasy; slow discovery; no game mechanics
